translations.attribution: Responsa of Rabbi Meir ben Gedaliah of Lublin. Digital text: Dicta — Israel Center for Text Analysis; edited text: Otzaria contributors, CC BY-SA 4.0. התכנים שלפניכם נאספו, מוינו, סוננו ונערכו בעמל רב ובמסירות על ידי צוות פרויקט 'אוצריא' (https://otzaria.org). Exact source file, repository revision and both providers' license evidence accompany this edition.
translations.changes: Amudi escaped HTML and divided existing source text into reading sections of at most 900 words before loading, preserving every source word in order. These are Amudi reading divisions, not canonical simanim or printed dapim. Amudi performed no OCR or translation. Copyrightable adaptations remain CC BY-SA 4.0. Source heading and bold tags were converted to text; the original marked-up file is included unchanged in the source bundle. Source responsum headings are retained.
translations.coverageStatus: All text in the reviewed Otzaria edited source. Its 139 responsum headings run from 1 to 140 but omit the heading for 138; that numbering/content gap remains unresolved and this is not claimed to be the complete historical work. The edited source restores the passage and responsa 28–29 lost where direct Dicta files 36 and 37 repeat. Existing digital text, sampled for coherence rather than proofread word by word. No English translation is included.
